beats_top.query: cornell parent how much spending money should I give my student per month
beats_top.why: The top results are generic national advice (Mercer, forum threads) with no Cornell numbers; our page gives Cornell's own non-billed estimate, a range by situation, and says what to do. It needs the year label and a consistent headline range to be trustworthy.
